sentences.en: I don't have enough money to buy the latest smartphone.
sentences.zh: 我手头的钱不够买最新的智能手机。

sentences.en: Smartphones would have seemed like science fiction ten years ago.
sentences.zh: 十年前，智能手机看起来像是科幻小说里的东西。

sentences.en: Is it very difficult to create an app for smartphones?
sentences.zh: 为智能手机开发一个应用程序很难吗？
